description: This file contains shell script test cases for verifying git commit authorship options, including tests for -C, -c, --amend, --reset-author, and related behaviors in git.

methods.name: author_header
methods.description: Extracts the author line from a commit object specified by its hash.

methods.name: message_body
methods.description: Extracts the commit message body from a commit object specified by its hash.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Converts a SHA1 hash into a file path in the .git/objects directory.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Deletes a git object file based on its SHA1 hash.
